tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the store catalog of gift cards, service top-ups and eSIM data plans. Returns matching products with their price, availability and product page URL.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one catalog product by id: available denominations with prices, required order inputs, and any countries where the code cannot be redeemed.
